entities.summary: Dormition Church of Kondopoga  was a Russian Orthodox Church in the town of Kondopoga, Kondopozhsky District of the Republic of Karelia. The church was located in the historic part of the town, in the former village of Kondopoga, on the shores of Lake Onega, in Kondopozhskaya Bay on a promontory jutting into Chupa Bay. At 42 meters, the church was the tallest wooden structure in Karelia. The height of the tent and log towers, two octagons and the quadrangle, and the quadrangular height and width are in the ratio of about 1:2.
